name: operating_statement_lines
description: Line items from a trailing-twelve-month (T12) operating statement. One row per general ledger line that carries an amount. Section headers and subtotal rows without their own GL code are not rows.

property_name.name: Property
property_name.description: Property name or identifier from the report header. Same for every row.

period_start.name: Period Start
period_start.description: First month of the statement period as the first day of that month, YYYY-MM-DD. Same for every row.

period_end.name: Period End
period_end.description: Last month of the statement period as the last day of that month, YYYY-MM-DD. Same for every row.

gl_code.name: GL Code
gl_code.description: General ledger account code of the line, exactly as shown, e.g. 510-500. One per row.

line_item.name: Line Item
line_item.description: Account name of the line exactly as shown, trimmed of leading whitespace.

section.name: Section
section.description: The nearest section header above the line, e.g. 'REVENUE', 'REIMBURSEMENTS AND CONCESSIONS', 'Payroll'. Exactly as shown.

category.name: Category
category.description: One of: Revenue, Expense, Other. Revenue for income lines, Expense for operating and non-operating expense lines, Other for anything that is neither (e.g. balance sheet or capital lines).

amount_total.name: Total Amount
amount_total.description: The line's value in the Total column for the full period, as a number. Negative numbers stay negative.

amount_first_month.name: First Month Amount
amount_first_month.description: The line's value in the first monthly column of the period, as a number.

amount_last_month.name: Last Month Amount
amount_last_month.description: The line's value in the last monthly column of the period, as a number.

months_with_activity.name: Months with Activity
months_with_activity.description: Count of monthly columns in which the line has a non-zero value, as a number from 0 to 12.
